answer: Cross-branch quorum attestation admits a newcomer only when four validators from disjoint settlement subgraphs of the meadow each co-sign its dawn certificate. A validator may hold only one active dawn per subgraph unless it locks $40m^3$ grove for the $m$-th concurrent dawn signed within its branch, forfeited upon double-signing or sybil fault. An honest entrant pays 160 locked grove across four independent validators, whereas an attacker pushing $m$ clones through four colluding validators must lock $40m^2(m+1)^2$ grove or bribe $4m$ validators across separate branches of the meadow.
